title: Sprint 1 - Database Initialization
description: Complete all MongoDB queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Create the Database
tickets.description:
Before we can create collections, we must switch to or initialize the MongoDB database. Switch to the database named `learning_lab`.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
-- SQLite creates the database automatically when you connect to a file.
-- Command line equivalent: sqlite3 learning_lab.db '.databases'
```
tasks: Before we can create collections, we must switch to or initialize the MongoDB database. Switch to the database named `learning_lab`.
learning_objectives: Understand how MongoDB switches to/initializes a database.
hints: Use the `use` command followed by the database name.
